sara: Quick RFC follow-up — we need a concrete opset handshake for quantized attention fusion (FP8/INT8/INT4). Main goals: safe kernel selection across host/runtime versions, cheap preflight QoS checks, and clear fallback semantics. Thoughts? :thinking:

mike: +1. My proposal: runtime advertises an opset id + small capability blob. Fields: opset_id, supported_precisions, quant_layout (per-tensor/per-channel), kv_cache_alignment_bytes, max_workspace_bytes, fallback_policy (enum: strict/soft/any), compat_hash. Keep it terse so it can be cached per model+device. Example handshake payload:```{
  "opset_id": "qattn-v1",
  "supported_precisions": ["fp8", "int8"],
  "quant_layout": "per-tensor",
  "kv_cache_alignment_bytes": 128,
  "max_workspace_bytes": 52428800,
  "fallback_policy": "soft",
  "compat_hash": "6a3f2c"
}```Keep compat_hash so we detect ABI drift without full opset bump. :+1:

jordan: Quick Q on kv_cache_alignment_bytes — if FP8 kernels pack KV with narrower lanes we need alignment hints so the runtime can avoid misaligned views. Is 64/128 a good default? Any perf numbers to justify 128? :eyes:

ekaterina: Bench data: on A100 p50 latency for fused FP8 attn is ~17% better than int8 when kv views are 128B-aligned. With 64B alignment we see occasional +6% tail. Also FP8 kernels allocate slightly more workspace (about +4MB in our test). Suggest handshake requires kernels to advertise both required_alignment and preferred_alignment and a cheap cache_probe API that returns whether the current model cache layout satisfies kernel constraints. If probe fails, runtime should consider fallback according to fallback_policy.

sara: This matches what I was thinking. Actionable plan: (1) define handshake schema with optional fields: required_alignment, preferred_alignment, probe_endpoint (name of kernel probe callback), and compatibility_hash. (2) runtime caches handshake per model/device, runs probe once on deploy (cheap mem-check) and stores result. (3) on mismatch use fallback_policy to pick next-best precision or async rollback to baseline kernel. Draft schema in issue. :shipit:

mike: Implementation notes: keep probe synchronous but extremely cheap (just a few pointer/size checks). Cache result keyed by model-sha + device-id + runtime-version. Metrics: record probe_result, fallback_reason, selected_kernel_id. Emit rollout event if we soft-fallback for >1% of requests. Failure modes to handle: mismatched quant_layout, insufficient workspace, ABI hash mismatch -> treat as strict failure unless fallback_policy == any.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket INF-3241 to add handshake schema, probe API, and metrics (owner: @mike). https://go/infra/INF-3241 :rocket:

sara: OK let's sync tomorrow 10am to finalize schema and add test vectors (small model with intentional misaligned KV). Thanks all. :thumbsup:
